What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Ghost]]: left, the image of [[Ghost (Errata)]] (holotable commit a57375e); right, the image of [[Ghost (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit 9d2c01e). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a57375eaf483d0e05592c08185b77505a415f0e5/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/ghost.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/ghost.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
